# pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit

Export, confirm, verify and import recovery kits.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`confirm`](#recovery-kit-confirm) | Confirm an exported kit by its checksum |
| [`export`](#recovery-kit-export) | Export a recovery kit (all storages by default) |
| [`import`](#recovery-kit-import) | Import keys (and optionally credentials) from a kit |
| [`show`](#recovery-kit-show) | Show a kit's contents (works without the daemon) |
| [`status`](#recovery-kit-status) | Show which repositories have a confirmed kit |
| [`verify`](#recovery-kit-verify) | Check a kit against the live repositories |

## recovery-kit confirm

Confirm an exported kit by its checksum.

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit confirm <checksum>
```

## recovery-kit export

Export a recovery kit (all storages by default).

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit export [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--confirm-checksum string` | confirm the kit non-interactively with its checksum |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing kit file |
| `--include-token` | include the remote's credentials (OAuth token) in the kit |
| `--kit-file string` | where to write the kit |
| `--kit-passphrase-file string` | encrypt the kit with the passphrase in this file |
| `--storage strings` | storages to include (comma separated; default all) |

## recovery-kit import

Import keys (and optionally credentials) from a kit.

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit import <file> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--import-token` | create missing remotes from credentials in the kit |
| `--passphrase-file string` | file holding the kit passphrase |

## recovery-kit show

Show a kit's repositories. With --show-secrets, print an rclone configuration for manual recovery with stock rclone.

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit show <file> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--passphrase-file string` | file holding the kit passphrase |
| `--show-secrets` | print keys and credentials as an rclone configuration |

## recovery-kit status

Show which repositories have a confirmed kit.

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit status
```

## recovery-kit verify

Check a kit against the live repositories.

```
pve-rclone-backup recovery-kit verify <file> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--passphrase-file string` | file holding the kit passphrase |

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
